note: Recast from Emerson 1928; the original is in English and describes the soldier only.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish yellow, darker in some specimens through preservation; sides of the head slightly rounded, only slightly narrowed anteriorly. Antenna 17 segments, segment 3 the smallest. A black spot behind the antennal base, presumably a reduced compound eye. Labrum not reaching the teeth of the left mandible. Anterior margin of the pronotum concave. Measurements (mm): head length 3.21—3.38; head width 1.48—1.61; pronotum length 0.58—0.64, width 1.03—1.09; hind tibia length 1.28; left mandible length 1.28.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Larger in body size than the nominotypical subspecies. The original notes that the mandible apex is less curved than in Termes pauperans. Holotype a soldier (American Museum of Natural History). Type localities: Senegambina, Cameroon, collected by B. C. Z. Evans on 1920-4-24 (numbers 228, 239) and on 1920-4-25 (number 244), and by R. N. Evans on 1920-4-29 (number 50); the description is based on several specimens.
